reasoning: A monitor or TV with a centered plus/cross and a right-pointing corner chevron. In a task list it strongly cues either telehealth/online patient portals (medical cross on a screen) or adding a secondary display / queuing media to watch next, though the double modifier makes its exact UI origin slightly ambiguous.

readings.meaning: telemedicine, telehealth, or online medical portal
add to queue, watchlist, or playlist
connect or extend to a second display or TV
PC diagnostics, system health, or computer repair

pass1.ambiguity: Combines two modifiers (a centered cross/plus and a right chevron) on a monitor; the centered cross reads strongly as healthcare/telemedicine, while the plus+chevron is a standard media UI glyph for 'add to queue / play next' or 'add display'.

distinguishing: Breaks the bottom-right corner of the monitor frame with a right-pointing chevron alongside the centered plus sign, specifically indicating 'play next', 'add to up-next queue', or forwarding/extending to another screen.
